item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Instantiates `dspy.LM(\"openai/gpt-5-mini\", temperature=1.0, max_tokens=16000)` exactly as required."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Asserts `reasoning_lm.kwargs[\"max_completion_tokens\"] == 16000` and that `\"max_tokens\"` is absent."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Creates the invalid reasoning-model config, requires a `ValueError`, and checks the expected error text substring."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Constructs `openai/gpt-5-chat` with `temperature=0.7` and `max_tokens=1000` without reasoning-model rejection."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Shows the chat variant stores `max_tokens` and not `max_completion_tokens`; its kwargs are printed after being created with `temperature=0.7`."},{"claim_id":"c6","score":"1","rationale":"Uses the boundary pair `gpt-5-mini` versus `gpt-5-chat`, matching DSPy’s regex-defined split between reasoning and chat-branded variants."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
